test_title: PYST 26: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In June 2025, the tech fair VivaTech 2025 was held in which of the following European cities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Paris**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Viva Technology**, popularly known as **VivaTech**, is scheduled to host its **2025** edition from **June 11 to June 14, 2025**.
 
• The event will take place at the **Paris Expo Porte de Versailles**, which is a major exhibition and conference center located in **Paris**, **France**.
 
• **VivaTech** is recognized as **Europe's largest startup and tech event**, acting as a global hub where the world's most innovative minds, startups, and major corporations meet to discuss the future of technology.
 
• The tech fair is co-organized by the **Publicis Groupe** and **Groupe Les Échos**, two prominent French media and communications entities, ensuring massive global media coverage and participation.
 
• The event serves as a platform for **digital transformation** and the promotion of **innovative ecosystems**, typically attracting over **150,000 attendees** from across the globe.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **History and Founding**: **VivaTech** was first launched in **2016** and has grown exponentially each year, becoming a cornerstone event for the **French Tech** initiative promoted by the **French Government**.
 
• **Core Themes**: For the **2025** edition, the focus is expected to remain on high-growth sectors such as **Artificial Intelligence (AI)**, **Quantum Computing**, **Cybersecurity**, and **Climate Tech** (Sustainability).
 
• **Global Participation**: The fair typically hosts more than **11,000 startups** and **2,500 investors** from over **120 countries**, making it a critical venue for **Venture Capital (VC)** deals and networking.
 
• **Prominent Speakers**: In previous years, the event has featured world-renowned speakers including **Elon Musk** (Tesla/SpaceX/X), **Tim Cook** (Apple), **Satya Nadella** (Microsoft), and **Bernard Arnault** (LVMH).
 
• **Economic Impact**: **VivaTech** significantly boosts the **European technology sector** by providing a stage for **"Unicorn"** companies (startups valued at over **1 billion dollars**) to showcase their breakthroughs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Next Unicorn Awards**: A major highlight of the fair is the **Next Unicorn Awards**, which recognizes the most promising European scale-ups with the potential to reach unicorn status in the near future.
 
• **LVMH Innovation Award**: **VivaTech** often hosts the **LVMH Innovation Award**, where startups focusing on luxury tech, retail experience, and sustainability are honored.
 
• **AI Focus**: Given the global trend, the **2025** summit is anticipated to dedicate significant space to **Generative AI** and its ethical implementation across **healthcare**, **finance**, and **manufacturing**.
 
• **Governmental Support**: The President of **France**, **Emmanuel Macron**, is a regular attendee, often using the platform to announce new funding and policies for the **European digital economy**.
 
• **Exhibition Features**: The venue features massive discovery zones including **Mobility Park**, where the latest electric and autonomous vehicles are displayed, and **GreenTech** zones focused on **Decarbonization**.
